en.headline: Girl, 17, arrested after mother reports suspected drug use in Yau Tong
en.dek: Police seized three suspected etomidate vape pods at a Yau Lai Estate flat after a late-night call on Tuesday; the teenager was held for alleged possession of dangerous drugs.
body: Police arrested a 17-year-old girl in Yau Tong late on Tuesday after her mother reported suspected drug use at a flat in Nga Lai House, Yau Lai Estate.

Officers who attended shortly after 11pm found three vape pods suspected to contain etomidate, a substance commonly sold in liquid form for electronic cigarettes. After preliminary inquiries, the girl was arrested on suspicion of possessing dangerous drugs and was detained for further investigation.
Etomidate has featured prominently in recent official figures on youth drug use in Hong Kong. The girl has not been charged in court. Police did not name her, in line with practice for a minor.

zh.headline: 油塘油麗邨17歲少女涉藏依托咪酯煙彈被捕
zh.dek: 母親周二深夜報案指女兒在家吸毒，警方在雅麗樓單位檢獲三粒懷疑依托咪酯煙彈，少女涉嫌管有危險藥物扣查。
body: 警方周二深夜接報，到油塘油麗邨雅麗樓一個單位調查懷疑吸毒，其後拘捕一名17歲少女，涉嫌管有危險藥物。
報案人是該少女的母親。警員約4晚上11時到達單位，檢獲三粒懷疑含有依托咪酯的電子煙彈。經初步調查後，少女被扣留調查。
依托咪酯近年常見於本港青少年吸毒個案。少女尚未在法庭被控，警方亦沒有公布姓名。
